\usepackage{uncial}

\begin{document}
    \begin{tikzpicture}
        \node[circle,draw=black,fill=white] (root) at (0, 0) {};

        \node[circle,draw=black,fill=white] (lchild) at ($(root.south) - (0.75, 0.25)$) {};

        \node (rchild) at ($(root.south) + (0.25, -0.4)$) {\unclfamily\Large{}C};
        \node (rrchild) at ($(rchild.south) - (0.5, 0.25)$) {\unclfamily\Large{}S};
        \node (rlchild) at ($(rchild.south) + (0.5, -0.25)$) {\unclfamily\Large{}C};

        \draw (root) -- (lchild);
        \draw (root) -- (rchild);
        \draw (rchild) -- (rlchild);
        \draw (rchild) -- (rrchild);
    \end{tikzpicture}
